scope: Round-1 independent audit of the 7 English keys PR #1452 adds (ui.canvas.files.attachments/attachmentsPartial/attachmentImage/attachmentRetained/attachmentGone/attachmentMeta, ui.chat.attachments.file_and_copy_missing) in ur, translated in 0a02713ed4 (scope 8953ae18b6..0a02713ed4). git diff 6bd3c93..0a02713ed4 -- src/i18n/catalogues changes no other English VALUE: three ui.canvas strings switch the escape \u2026 to a literal U+2026 (parsed values identical). findings.issue: In the RTL document the unisolated placeholders reorder: CoreText (NSParagraphStyle baseWritingDirection RTL) lays out "286 KB · 27 اکتوبر" as screen L→R [اکتوبر][KB · 27][286], i.e. the day number sits beside KB and away from its month. With FSI/PDI around each placeholder value it lays out [اکتوبر][27][ · ][286 KB], which reads correctly.
findings.disposition: Not a translation defect and the catalogue value stays unchanged: the ur guide forbids manual bidi controls in translations and the glossary forbids reordering placeholders. Fix belongs to the renderer: isolate {size}/{when} (wrap each value in U+2068…U+2069 in attachmentNote, or render via <bdi>). Non-gating.

limitations: No browser or app launch; no rendered-fit screenshots or pseudo-localization. The row meta is a shrink-0 span beside a truncating file name, so the longer locales (vi/hi attachmentGone at 50 chars against en 32) squeeze the name instead of overflowing: a design-review concern, not a translation defect.
